help:
Allows you to play Multi Theft Auto in peace, without worrying about another player being in your face.
To use, enter "/hide ui" to open its UI to change settings. They're stored locally and are per server.
Additionally, you can type "/hide" followed by a number to switch just the hide type. Or "/hide" without anything to cycle through available types.
"/hide 0" (Disabled) - Turns off SASS - No additional hiding beyond normal transparency will be applied "/hide 1" (Fade) - Turns on distance based SASS - Players will change transparency based on distance "/hide 2" (Fade+) - Turns on advanced distance based SASS - Works the same as 1, but also hides players if they're too close "/hide 3" (Hide) - Turns on full SASS - Fully hides other players
When "Alt. Ghost Mode" is enabled it will set your own vehicle (or the one of the player you're spectating) opaque. When "Enable When Spectating" is enabled it will treat the player you're spectating as "you" and will apply the hide type you have selected. If it's disabled it will treat it as hide type 0 (disabled)
SASS only works on non-collision requiring races. Not on Destruction Derbies or (most) minigames and not on races that have collision turned on.
SASS will attempt to remember your settings between races, and if you're logged into an account it will store your last selected state in your account data.
